## Description

/patients/new full mode, India: steps Identity & IDs → Contact & address → Family & emergency (MDV-P1-020) → Payer → Consents (MDV-P1-019) → Review (MDV-P1-016). Identity: first/last name, DOB or age ("estimated"), sex at birth, optional gender identity, preferred language, ABHA number (14 digits) and address (optional, manual entry; "Verify with ABHA" banner shows the P8 path as disabled/coming later), other ID type with Aadhaar last 4 only. Contact: mobile (required), alternate, email, house/flat, street, city, district, state/UT, PIN (6 digits), country. Payer: self-pay / corporate / private insurance (TPA) / government scheme (reference only). Side panel shows preview card and "Data map · this step writes".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Minimum to register (India): name, DOB or age, sex, mobile; other fields optional; validation messages match the design (e.g. "PIN code must be 6 digits").
- [ ] **AC2.** Aadhaar can only be stored as last 4 digits; entering 12 digits is rejected with an explanation; ABHA is stored via Always Encrypted and is never required for care.
- [ ] **AC3.** On save, PATIENT (demographics), PATIENT_IDENTIFIER (tokenised), PAYER_COVERAGE, CONSENT_RECEIPT and AUDIT_EVENT PatientRegistered.v1 (no PHI in payload) are written in one transaction and a facility-scoped MRN is assigned.
- [ ] **AC4.** The success screen shows name, MRN, timestamp and actor and offers Book appointment · Check in now (walk-in) · Register another.
- [ ] **AC5.** The receptionist cannot see any clinical data from the registration or directory screens (security test).
- [ ] **AC6.** Form is keyboard-completable, errors announced via aria-live, works at tablet width.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
